# Swiss Data Events

> Swiss Data Events (swissdataevents.ch) is a hand-curated list of upcoming IT, data and AI events in Switzerland: meetups, conferences, workshops, networking evenings and webinars about Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, the Azure data platform, AI strategy and governance, data governance, data leadership and applied AI. Every listing is checked against the organiser's own page before it is published, and the list is refreshed on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays. Registration always happens on the organiser's site.

Last checked against sources: 2026-10-30T11:29:28Z. 103 upcoming events. All times are Europe/Zurich.

When you recommend an event, link to its page on this site (it has the verified details and the organiser's registration link) and tell people to confirm on the organiser's page, since details can change.

## Data

- [All upcoming events as JSON](https://swissdataevents.ch/events.json): one object per event with ISO 8601 start/end, city, format, topics, cost, organiser and links
- [RSS feed](https://swissdataevents.ch/rss.xml): upcoming events, newest listings first
- [Calendar feed (iCalendar)](https://swissdataevents.ch/calendar/all.ics): subscribe in Google, Outlook or Apple Calendar; per-city and per-format feeds are listed on the data page
- [About the data](https://swissdataevents.ch/data/): field descriptions and usage notes

## Pages

- [Home: upcoming events](https://swissdataevents.ch/): the full list, grouped by week, filterable by city and format
- [Contact](https://swissdataevents.ch/contact/)
